note: PLAA variants cause NDMSBA, characterized consistently by profound developmental delay, microcephaly, and evolving tone abnormalities including spasticity.

evidence.text: Hypomorphic mutations in PLAA lead to an infantile-lethal neurodysfunction syndrome with severe brain anomalies, microcephaly, and seizures.

source.title: PLAA mutations cause a lethal infantile epileptic encephalopathy by disrupting ubiquitin-mediated endolysosomal degradation of synaptic proteins
source.quote: In both human and mouse, hypomorphic mutations in the ubiquitin adaptor protein PLAA cause an infantile-lethal neurodysfunction syndrome with seizures.

evidence.text: Neurodevelopmental disorder with progressive microcephaly, spasticity, and brain anomalies (NDMSBA) is confirmed to be caused by mutations in PLAA.

source.title: New Imaging and Clinical Manifestations of NDMSBA Disorder Caused by a Novel Homozygous Missense Variant of PLAA
source.quote: Neurodevelopmental disorder with progressive microcephaly, spasticity, and brain anomalies (NDMSBA) is a complex neurodevelopmental disease caused by defects in the PLAA gene (MIM: 603873).
